setting: You all live in Leipzig, Germany, and you know each other from walking dogs in the same park. Eva, you work as a barista in a café; Thomas, you drive a bus part-time; Tobias, you test software. In this chat you coordinate who covers which dog walks around your shifts and work, and share updates about the dogs.

text: Bruno got the all clear from the vet today!! Cone is off 🙌 short leash walks only for 2 more weeks tho, no park runs
That's good news. Tell him the cone was a disgrace
Ha he hated it. Kept walking into doors
Nice! So who takes him on the 7th? Still on leash so no fetch
Me, I'll keep him on the paths by the lake
Stay off the meadow by the north gate then. Full of sticks right now
Lol that's where he got the paw in the first place, glass 😬
Then I'll walk past there Monday and check it. Night
I can take him friday if you need, I'm off that day
